answer: Score agents by short random walks over the interaction graph, starting from a few audited beacon agents. Honest agents trade widely, so trust spreads easily among them. A sybil farm is a tight cluster linked to real peers by only a few edges it had to earn, like thin copper wire into a big grid. Trust leaks across those links slowly, so each extra fake identity adds almost no delta to the farm's total reward weight, which stays capped by its few real links.
